_source: read off the live SROT board over MAVLink, /dev/ttyUSB0 @115200 from mongla.local, 2026-09-23
_why: config.h defaults are NOT what this vehicle runs. PILOT_YAW_RATE ships at 45.0 and reads back 160.0 -- a 3.556x error on every yaw torque computed from the defaults. Load this before any claim about the attitude cascade.
_gain_note: JS_GAIN_DEFAULT is the power-on value only; the LIVE gain is runtime and steppable 0.10..1.00 by joystick button. sp_yaw = (r/1000)*gain, mav_commands.cpp:736. At GAIN 1.0 a host yaw_pct of 5.0 is sp_yaw 0.05; at 0.5 it is 0.025 and every threshold below doubles.

_not_a_param._note: these are real board params, but nothing the bench links reads them -- FRAME_REVERSE and the motor directions are applied by control_bench.drive(), and MOVE_CRUISE_MAX lives in movement.cpp which the bench does not link. Kept here as evidence, not as bench input.
